newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli dies of wounds from July bombing.
newsitem.headline: Israeli dies of wounds from July bombing.

text.p: An Israeli man wounded in the July 30 suicide bombing in Jerusalem died on Monday, bringing the death toll in the attack to 16, including the two Moslem militant bombers.
A spokesman for Jerusalem's Hadassah Hospital named the victim as Eli Adourian, 49. "He was in the intensive care unit...He didn't make it," spokesman Yossi Shoval said.

The twin bombings deepened a crisis between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) over peacemaking. Israel accuses the PLO of not fighting militants opposed to the peace and has suspended negotiations until there is a crackdown.

The PLO says it has fought militants. It accuses Israel of imposing collective punishment on the Palestinians. Immediately after the bombing Israel sealed off the West Bank and Gaza Strip, disrupting trade and barring workers from Israel.
U.S. envoy Dennis Ross is in the region trying to put negotiations back on track.
